attributes.name: Temperbrand
attributes.powers:
You may automatically acquire this card, if you do, you are dealt 1d4 Fire damage.

Recharge this card to add 1d12 to your combat check. If the check does not have the Fire trait, add the Fire trait and after the check, you are dealt 1 Fire damage.

Bury this card to add 2d12 and the Fire trait to a combat check by a character at your location.
